# fbx, une CLI pour ta Freebox

[![CI (GitLab)](https://git.nech.pl/pln/fbx/badges/master/pipeline.svg)](https://git.nech.pl/pln/fbx/-/commits/master)
[![CI (GitHub)](https://github.com/plnech/fbx/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/plnech/fbx/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

An unofficial, full-coverage command line into a Freebox OS router's panel API.
The web panel is just a JavaScript client over a REST API, and `fbx` is the
missing terminal client for that dialect.

## Install

```sh
pipx install git+https://git.nech.pl/pln/fbx.git     # or the mirror below
pipx install git+https://github.com/plnech/fbx.git
```

From a clone, poetry does it all (venv + the `fbx` entry point):

```sh
git clone https://git.nech.pl/pln/fbx && cd fbx && poetry install
```

No install? `python -m fbx_cli.cli` works from the repo root.

## Quickstart (under a minute)

```sh
fbx version        # reachability check, no login needed
fbx login          # panel-dialect auth (1Password or --stdin; never argv)
fbx wan            # live WAN state and rates
fbx tldr           # ten more copy-pasteable examples
```

## What it is

The Freebox panel speaks its own dialect (different paths, form posts, a
challenge-based login) that is documented nowhere and is *not* the well-known
developer API. `fbx` transcribes that dialect once (clean-room, from the
panel's own publicly-served JavaScript, see [docs/api/](docs/api/)) and
drives **15 domains, 183 endpoint records, 292 operations** through one
generic engine. Everything the panel can see, so does your shell.

- **Grammar, not GUI**: `fbx <domain> <thing>` to read, `add`/`set`/`rm`
  where documented, body fields as auto-typed `key=value` pairs.
- **Destructive ops are gated**: storage format/fsck, raid member ops, fs
  rm/mv, reboot/shutdown, token revocation all refuse to run without `--yes`.
- **Escape hatch**: `fbx api GET|POST <path> [body]` reaches anything the
  generated commands miss.
- **Global flags anywhere on the line**: `--json` (raw envelope),
  `--debug` (method+path+status, never bodies), `--yes`.

## Auth, in one paragraph

`fbx` mirrors the panel exactly: `GET login/` returns a password salt and a
*challenge*: a table of ~32 obfuscated JavaScript snippets the panel
`eval()`s one per character. `fbx` runs the box's own snippets through a
one-shot `node` subprocess, computes
`HMAC-SHA1(key=SHA1(salt+password), msg=challenge)`, posts it form-encoded,
and stores the session cookie `chmod 600` under `~/.config/freebox/session/`
(never printed). One automatic re-authentication on auth errors. The password
comes from 1Password (`op read`: the item named by the `FREEBOX_OP_REF`
env var, a one-line `~/.config/freebox/opref` file, or the default item) or
from `fbx login --stdin`; never argv, never disk. You need `node` installed.

|---|---:|---|
| [`wifi`](docs/cmd/wifi.md) | 20 | state/config, ap, bss, stations, mlo, mac-filter, guest keys, wps, steering |
| `downloads` | 18 | task queue, add, trackers, peers, files, blacklist, throttling, rss, [docs](docs/cmd/downloads.md) |
| `tv` | 17 | channels, bouquets, epg, pvr, dvb, [docs](docs/cmd/tv.md) |
| `connection` | 16 | WAN state, xdsl/lte, ipv6, ddns, logs, rrd graphs, [docs](docs/cmd/connection.md) |
| `storage` | 16 | disks, partitions, raid, fsck, internal storage, [docs](docs/cmd/storage.md) |
| `fs` | 15 | ls, cp/mv/rm, extract/archive, tasks, share links, binary get/put, [docs](docs/cmd/fs.md) |
| `fw` | 15 | incoming, port redir, dmz, upnp, netshare (samba/afp), ftp, tftp, parental, [docs](docs/cmd/fw.md) |
| `lan` | 14 | config, devices, hosts, wol, routes, dhcp, dhcpv6, switch, freeplug, [docs](docs/cmd/lan.md) |
| `contacts` | 13 | entries, numbers/emails/addresses, groups, vCard import/export, [docs](docs/cmd/contacts.md) |
| `system` | 10 | health, reboot/shutdown, standby, lcd, ledstrip, sfp, licenses, [docs](docs/cmd/system.md) |
| `vpn` | 10 | servers, ip pool, users, live connections, vpn client, [docs](docs/cmd/vpn.md) |
| `phone` | 9 | hardware, sip, dect, paging, call log, [docs](docs/cmd/phone.md) |
| `accounts` | 4 | profiles, groups, notification targets, [docs](docs/cmd/accounts.md) |
| `auth` | 3 | sessions, permissions, app tokens, [docs](docs/cmd/auth.md) |
| `airmedia` | 3 | config, receivers, cast, [docs](docs/cmd/airmedia.md) |

## Command wiki

Every command has a generated reference page under
[`docs/cmd/`](docs/cmd/): synopsis, exact usage, a **synthetic** happy-path
example (the raw envelope and exactly what rich prints) and the error
envelopes you meet in practice. [`docs/cmd/core.md`](docs/cmd/core.md)
covers `version`/`login`/`logout`/`api`. The pages are regenerated by
`tools/gen_wiki.py` and CI fails if a record changes without its page.

## FAQ

**Is this official?** No. Unofficial, not affiliated with, nor endorsed by,
Free SAS or Freebox. "Freebox" is a trademark of Free SAS; this project only
interoperates with the product, and is meant for **your own box** on your own
LAN.

**Is my password safe?** The ladder: pipe it (`fbx login --stdin`), or let fbx
read it from 1Password at runtime (`op`; the item is resolved as
`FREEBOX_OP_REF` env, then a one-line `~/.config/freebox/opref` file kept
`chmod 600`, then the default item). It is
never in argv, never written to disk, never printed; the session cookie lives
`chmod 600` under `~/.config/freebox/` and auto re-login is one retry. Set
`FREEBOX_HOST` if your LAN is renumbered (the default, `fd0f:ee:b0::1`, is the
stock Freebox ULA).

**My box updated and something broke?** The panel's served JavaScript is the
spec: re-transcribe the changed endpoint into `docs/api/`, fix the record,
and the fixture tests plus the wiki freshness gate catch the drift. Until
then `fbx api` covers gaps.
